payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute prefix sums per character. For each character c, iterate all substrings to compute the number of needed changes, storing the max length in dp[c][k]. Then make dp monotonic to answer queries in O(1).
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D table dp[character][changes] to store the maximal length obtainable with at most k changes, which is a classic 2D DP state.
